product.title: BOW Sports Capital: Pregame
product.summary: A twelve-week single-player front-office season with a running CBA glossary.
product.whatStudentsDo: Students take a team through a twelve-week season as club president, making a major decision each week plus minor ones, working a trade deadline and a finale, while a glossary panel defines each cap term as it becomes relevant. Owner patience running out ends the run.

studentDataProfile.notes: State kept in browser localStorage only; no server call observed.
